description: An interface defining methods for device credential representations used for authentication in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: DeviceCredentials
classes.description: An interface for device credentials used in authentication, providing methods to retrieve the credential type, device identity, and tenant ID.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of credentials the device presents.

methods.name: getAuthId
methods.description: Returns the authentication ID of the device.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID associated with the device credentials.
